notes.title: Multiple mise à jour
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I updated Space Probes with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Overhaul of the save system with internal development
[*] Redesign of the trophy notification system with internal development
[*] Redesign of the management of the controllers (we use the one of Unity now)
[*] Added a new rear fire, with some ships coming from the rear in level 0. It is also used to destroy enemy missiles that pass behind.
[*] New level 0 ending - I've set up a wink of one of the best games in the world :) Can you recognize it?
[*] Removal of the shop for level 0 because you start this level with a lot of skills
[*] Various additions such as the display of "safe zones" in level 5, Laser of the level 2 boss or the replacement of the red background on the Who'z Da Boss mode
[/list]

[b]Update soon:[/b] We are preparing a novelty for fun, but which promises to be very friendly and funny. We redo all the sound effects and music of the game ... by voice. It will be an option to activate in the options :) In addition to that I always think about new things for the game, improve the levels, add game phases, make diagonal shots with game phases which will exploit this function etc

That's all for now :p

Sincerely, Xavier

notes.title: Space Probes becomes Free
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/8bada18e248f2949a513827213b9d7ce1e231f80.jpg[/img]

[h1]Space Probes becomes Free [/h1]

It's time for Space Probes to go free! My wish for this game was never to win money, it is above all a childhood dream to be able to make a game, I succeeded and I am very proud of it. It took a long time, I started from scratch.

Now the goal of Space Probes is for it to be played by more players, I would like more players to be able to play it without having the payment border. That's why I decided to make Space Probes completely free, with no ads and no in-game purchases.

Space Probes will become free by next week, while our dear friends at Steam validate the switch to Free.

I would like to thank all the people who spent a few euros to play my game, thank you very much :)

I wish you all a good game :-)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/142586097a9dd675b152b65804768f74cd088c38.jpg[/img]

notes.title: News on Space Probes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/7dfb693a553e2e232d154f375dbb7648244bbcf8.png[/img]

We have implemented quite a few new things in Space Probes and fixed various bugs.

[h1]The news[/h1]

We have implemented 2 new game modes, an "Easy" mode, which allows you to get three times the money when you collect orbs. This mode is interesting for less skilled players :)

We have also added a "Legendary" mode, for real shmuppers, this mode leaves you only 3way, 4way and Speed for purchase. No other Skills are purchasable! A real challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/d3807934868d91616b8fcb94012929c691914300.jpg[/img]

We also added a new Skill: [b]Orbital Probes[/b]
Two satellites revolve around your ship

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/504fd68f9364f0a4b7c29fdbfff5b231d6e6aa4a.jpg[/img]

Drones reactors are now generated randomly between 4 reactors (4 colors)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/4d1feae98031bdd7975288d2892d1049f2daf4a4.jpg[/img]

We have also put a visual element for the Dash, located next to the Bullet Time, it lets you know if the skill is available or not.

[h1]The fixes[/h1]

We fixed an issue with the object pooler, the 4ways are now properly disabled when encountering an enemy.

We have also improved the "homing missiles", if a missile has chased an enemy and it is destroyed by another shot, the missile will again search for a nearby target and so on.

We are very attentive, do not hesitate to send us your ideas, they could be integrated into the game, this has been the case on several occasions! Thanks to them ! (gdh_percris and ¡Rhythm Sage!)

notes.title: We are ready !
notes.content:
[h1] Space probes is ready! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/3e852a114db197c3003fa6855a36dde9756a0a01.jpg[/img]

Today we pushed a new version of the game.
This is accompanied by a [b] new level [/b], the [b] final boss [/b] and the [b] end of the game [/b].

It also includes the correction of the following bugs:

- English translations of missing pages (Trophies, Level Select etc.)
- A problem with the keyboard and gamepad configuration when launching the game for the first time has been fixed

This last bug was annoying, because you had to go through the game options to map these keys to be able to play :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/cca679f116df74710c44faf3cf50d07fe1466403.png[/img]

We will ask Steam to validate the release of the game, it should normally arrive sooner than expected :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1309980/Space_Probes/

notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/497b39ab0cf22305543dd03b7ea97c45d900eef2.png[/img][h2]Key mapping - Gamepad and Keyboard[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/58a1403947dc31bb9f21fbe6bcb94e8202351c9e.jpg[/img]

Dear Beta-testers friends, today we have added to Space Probes the possibility of mapping the keys of your favorite controller and also the possibility of mapping the keys of the keyboard. So you can set up the solution best suited to your way of playing :)

To use this new options go to the "Options" menu then "Controller".

[h2]Boss Rush in a dynamic 7th level[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37853439/98173e3bfcfea22d1943c98f6dd5cc1904452443.jpg[/img]

This update also arrives with a 7th level that will put your reflexes to the test! 
I let you discover it for yourself!

To finish, do not hesitate to send us back the various bugs that you may have encountered so that we can work on it.

The update is available immediately! Good Game everyone

See you soon !
